weight.counter_signal: Rich is credible if coconut/butter structures the remainder strongly. Light remains possible with dominant mobile-oil behavior but is less persuasive against the combined richer and structural signals.
weight.reason: B1/B3/B6: light-leading sunflower and fluid jojoba/safflower are countered by principal medium-prior avocado/argan, rich-prior coconut and supporting seed butter. The combined lipid argument supports intermediate coating rather than a simple light-leading tie-break. Predominantly fluid oil architecture opposes a rich floor from butter presence.
weight.unresolved: No amounts, grades, temperature or butter specification; no neat pomegranate prior is transferred to its unlisted parenthetical spelling.

penetration_potential.counter_signal: The sunflower/avocado/jojoba/argan carrier system and supporting butter can sustain a surface coating. Unknown proportions and film interactions make surface_led credible, and positive potential does not establish a measured delivered fraction.
penetration_potential.reason: Corrected exact safflower rank 5 and coconut rank 6 are admitted positive anchors and already belong to the principal botanical conditioning-oil sequence. Their joint participation in that backbone supports a low-confidence positive estimate; no principal-role changes were introduced.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula delivery measurement. The whole-oil anchor study used 1 g oil/g hair for 24 h at 40 C; botanical/grade and lab-to-ordinary-use transfer limit the estimate.
